lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Heavenly Father I worship You, (2)
I love You, adore You,
Bow down before You,
Heavenly Father I worship You.

[Verse 2]
Son of God, what a wonder
You are (2)
You saved me from sin
Put your Holy Ghost within,
Son of God what a wonder You are.

[Verse 3]
Holy Ghost, what a comfort
You are (2)
You lead us and guide us,
You live right inside us
Holy Ghost, what a comfort
You are.

[Verse 4]
Brother, Sister, I appreciate you, (2)
With God's love inside us,
We'll glorify Jesus
Brother, Sister, I appreciate you.
